verdict.rationale: CDP documents Coinbase Onramp for moving value from fiat to crypto. The docs say users can buy crypto with a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a Coinbase account, with delivery straight to their wallet, and the fund skill explicitly covers buying USDC via Onramp. Missing for 10: explicit bank-transfer (ACH/SEPA) purchase support, details of the embeddable widget or API integration (URL/session parameters, UI embedding), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
